description: Conformance vectors for the SRL scientific object fabric (WP-B11): six object types (ScientificClaim, MathIR, SymbolTable, ConditionSet, ConstantRef, ModelInterface) and the MathIR allowlist + resource guards. Each positive vector is a valid object that must validate against its schema (and pass the Python validator where one exists). Each negative vector names the contract reason its input must be rejected with.

positive.name: p01-math-ir-newton
positive.description: Newton's second law F = m*a as a MathIR expression tree over the restricted OpenMath allowlist (relation1.eq, arith1.times).

positive.name: p02-claim-newton
positive.description: Newton's second law as an established_law_reference claim WITH a support_ref and epistemic_source=literature (satisfies the established-law invariant).

positive.name: p03-claim-hypothesis
positive.description: A bare candidate_hypothesis claim (proposed, unsupported) — a hypothesis that has not graduated to supported.

positive.name: p04-symbol-table
positive.description: A symbol table with units and positivity domains for the harmonic-oscillator symbols.

positive.name: p05-constant-ref-newton
positive.description: A ConstantRef for the Newton unit (force), value carried as a decimal string, unit in UCUM form (kg.m.s-2).

positive.name: p06-condition-set
positive.description: A ConditionSet of positivity assumptions on k and m (inline MathIR, allowlist-compliant).

positive.name: p07-model-interface-oscillator
positive.description: A ModelInterface for the harmonic oscillator (kind=ode) with state variables, parameters, governing MathIR ref, and an empty composition list (atomic).

negative.name: n01-unknown-operator
negative.reason: arith1.log is a known content dictionary (arith1) but an unknown name; rejected by the allowlist with IR_UNSUPPORTED.

negative.name: n02-unknown-cd
negative.reason: foo1 is not an accepted content dictionary; rejected by the allowlist with IR_UNSUPPORTED.

negative.name: n03-bool-as-int-exponent
negative.reason: A bool is not a decimal-string constant; the const channel rejects bool-as-int with CONTRACT_INVALID.

negative.name: n04-established-law-no-literature
negative.reason: established_law_reference requires epistemic_source=literature; rejected by the claim invariant with CONTRACT_INVALID.

negative.name: n05-candidate-supported-no-support
negative.reason: A candidate_hypothesis cannot carry claim_status=supported without support_refs; rejected by the claim invariant with CONTRACT_INVALID.

negative.name: n06-ir-depth-bomb
negative.reason: An expression deeper than the 64-node depth guard is rejected by the resource guard with CONTRACT_INVALID.

negative.name: n07-ir-node-flood
negative.reason: An expression with more than 10000 nodes (breadth-heavy, depth 2) is rejected by the resource guard with CONTRACT_INVALID.
